meta.title: 面试被问婚育状况：分情况回答思路
meta.title_en: How to Answer Marital-Status Questions in Interviews

scenes.title_en: Why interviewers ask about marriage and kids
scenes.context: 讲者拆解面试官问婚姻状况的两个真正用意：工作精力投入度和稳定性。
sentences: 我们女生在求职的时候被问到婚姻状况，怎么回答比较合适呢？
When we're asked about our marital status during a job hunt, how should we answer?
婚姻状况：marital status
问这个问题其实主要是两方面的考量：一个就是你在工作上的精力投入度。
There are really two things behind this question: first, how much energy you can put into work.
精力投入度：energy commitment to work
二个就是你的稳定性。
Second, how stable you'll be.
稳定性：how stable you'll be
paraphrase: 问婚育≠打探私生活→问两个工作变量
It's not prying into your life; it's two work-related variables.
答婚育=回答精力和稳定性
Answering it means addressing energy and stability.
scenes.speak: When we're asked about our marital status during a job hunt, how should we answer? There are really two things behind this question: first, how much energy you can put into work. Second, how stable you'll be.

scenes.title_cn: 未婚未孕与已婚已孕的答法
scenes.title_en: Scripts for single and married-with-kids candidates
scenes.context: 讲者给出未婚未孕（有对象）和已婚已孕两种情况的回答重点。
sentences: 未婚未孕有对象的话，回答重点要传递两方面的信息：最重要的就是告诉面试官你近期的工作计划。
If you're single with a partner, focus on two things: most importantly, your near-term work plan.
近期工作计划：near-term work plan
其次要表明你的强稳定性，比如说已经在这里定居了等等。
Second, show strong stability — for example, that you're already settled here.
已经定居：already settled here
对于已婚已孕的姐妹，重点传递：在实现自我价值的同时，是希望给孩子树立一个好榜样。
For married moms, the key is that while fulfilling yourself, you also want to set a good example for your child.
树立好榜样：set a good example
paraphrase: 未婚未孕→说规划＋说定居
已婚已孕→说职业目标＋孩子榜样
Married with kids: talk goals and leading by example.
scenes.speak: If you're single with a partner, focus on two things: most importantly, your near-term work plan. Second, show strong stability — for example, that you're already settled here. For married moms, the key is that while fulfilling yourself, you also want to set a good example for your child.

scenes.title_cn: 已婚未孕与参考项真相
scenes.title_en: The married-no-kids script and the truth
scenes.context: 讲者给出已婚未孕的答法，并点破婚育只是参考项、能力素养才决定录用。
sentences: 已婚未孕，回答时一定要表达想先打好物质基础和职业基础，近期没有生育计划。
If you're married without kids, stress that you want to build your financial and career foundations first and have no baby plans soon.
打好基础：build the foundations
虽然上面这些话都是面上的套话，但是你还是得说，而且要说得彼此都很舒服。
These are all face-saving scripts, but you still have to say them — and say them so both sides feel comfortable.
面上的套话：face-saving scripts
婚姻状况只是一个参考项，决定录不录你的关键因素取决于你的专业能力和个人综合素养。
Marital status is just a reference; what decides the offer is your professional skill and overall quality.
综合素养：overall quality / all-round capability
paraphrase: 已婚未孕→先基础＋家人共识
Married without kids: foundations first, family on board.
套话说舒服→但能力才是底牌
Say the script smoothly, but competence is the real card.
scenes.speak: If you're married without kids, stress that you want to build your financial and career foundations first and have no baby plans soon. These are all face-saving scripts, but you still have to say them — and say them so both sides feel comfortable. Marital status is just a reference; what decides the offer is your professional skill and overall quality.

practice: In the next one to three years, my focus is on hitting my career goals.
I'm settled in this city, so you don't need to worry about stability.
My family and I are on the same page about my career plans.
I believe what matters most is my ability and how well I fit the role.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I will not marry or have kids in two years.
✓ 地道说法：I have no plans for marriage or kids in the near term.
用 have no plans 表达「没有计划」，比否定句承诺更自然可信。
✕ 直译腔：My child is seen by my parents.
✓ 地道说法：My parents help take care of the child.
被老人看用 help take care of，避免被动生硬。
✕ 直译腔：Marriage status is only a reference item.
✓ 地道说法：Marital status is just a reference point.
✕ 直译腔：I want to lay a good material foundation first.
✓ 地道说法：I want to build my financial and career foundations first.
shifts: 被问婚育就紧张解释私生活
把问题翻译成「精力和稳定性」来回答
把套话当承诺，指望面试官相信
套话说舒服就行，别指望一句打消顾虑
知道婚育只是参考，能力与素养才是关键
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「是俗言问」校正为「面试官问」，「两方面的过程」校正为「两方面的考量」，「强稳定性」校正为「强（调）稳定性」，「后顾身忧」校正为「后顾之忧」，「有家庭阿姨」校正为「有家庭阿姨（家政）」，确认「面试关系也跟明镜一样」按语境保留，「一过世又新交爆怀孕」校正为「面试通过后又宣布怀孕」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
